Put the files of your original DOS Gunboat (Accolade, 1990) in this folder: the contents of its
disks, or of the folder it was installed in. They are not included with the port.

The port reads:

  GB.EXE                          the game (as shipped, EXEPACK-packed; an unpacked copy works too)
  DATAA.DAT DATAB.DAT DATAC.DAT   pictures, worlds, missions, texts
  VALK12.MUS / VALKPC.MUS         the title music on the AdLib / on the PC speaker
  ADLIB.COM                       optional: the Ad Lib sound driver (without it: PC speaker music)
  GUNBOAT.CFG, GBROSTER.DAT       optional: the configuration, and the roster the game writes

The names may be in any case. The folder must be writable: the game saves its roster here.
